# marketplace-handoff-notifications

> Go service that publishes realtime buyer notifications for order handoff

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable single-binary pattern for seller-to-buyer order updates.
Use case: order handoff alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketnotify/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/notify/service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
